Streaming chat completion where the assistant responds with a tool call across multiple chunks

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.literllm.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var reqJson = "{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"What is the weather in NYC?\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"stream\":true,\"tools\":[{\"function\":{\"description\":\"Get the current weather for a given location\",\"name\":\"get_weather\",\"parameters\":{\"properties\":{\"location\":{\"description\":\"The city and state, e.g. New York, NY\",\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"location\"],\"type\":\"object\"}},\"type\":\"function\"}]}";
        var req = JsonUtil.fromJson(reqJson, ChatCompletionRequest.class);
        var apiKey = System.getenv("API_KEY");
        if (apiKey == null || apiKey.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalStateException("API_KEY must be set");
        try (var client = LiterLlm.createClient(apiKey, null, null, null, null)) {
        var result = client.chatStream(req);
        System.out.println(result);
        }
    }
}
```
